column1: # Every repository that pins this one as a submodule, and where the pin is.
# A submodule is a commit, not a branch, so pushing to main here changes nothing
# anywhere else: each consumer keeps the commit it recorded, builds, passes its
# tests, and runs the old chip until somebody moves it. Nothing detects that -
# there is no version to compare and no resolver to complain - and the symptom
# is a board behaving the way it did before the fix, which is exactly what
# somebody chasing the fix expects to be looking at.
# So this file exists to be read by ci.yml's `consumers` job, which asks GitHub
# what each row pins and says which ones lag. A consumer left out of it is a
# consumer that silently stays behind for ever; add the row in the same commit
# repository<TAB>path to the submodule in it
